svg.title: Map of the NAPTOSA network: the national hub and South Africa's nine provinces
svg.desc: Illustrative map. Node positions are illustrative and do not mark office locations. The national hub is drawn offshore because the national site serves every province. Western Cape keeps its existing site; the other eight provinces get a new or rebuilt site. Lesotho and Eswatini are separate countries and appear as gaps. Province outlines: Natural Earth, public domain, simplified.
